applicabilityBasis.summary: Current Theo documentation describes thGOLD as a non-rebasing, non-appreciating token pegged to one troy ounce of physical gold, with any yield confined to separate sthGOLD. GENIUS monetary value concerns national currency or deposits denominated in it; this commodity unit does not disclose an issuer obligation to redeem for a fixed amount of monetary value. Assess non-payment-token/not-applicable rather than infer that the token itself is a security from its historical MG999 backing description.

genius.notes: Current canonical documentation supersedes the older fund-exposure description for perimeter assessment: one thGOLD tracks one troy ounce of physical gold and does not appreciate with yield. A separate sthGOLD position receives yield. No token-specific securities-law determination was identified. The existing pre-launch lifecycle and historical MG999 description conflict with current documentation stating thGOLD is available on secondary venues, while direct mint/redeem is still forthcoming. Non-payment-token is a GENIUS perimeter assessment and establishes no MiCA authorization or financial-instrument exclusion.
